environment.description: FastAPI service deployed behind an Envoy sidecar proxy (v1.28) in an EKS pod with an Istio service mesh. The Envoy configuration includes a custom Lua filter on the ingress gateway that tracks session cookie values per source IP using a shared Redis instance. The filter enforces a sliding-window counter (window=60s, max_tokens=3) specifically on requests to paths matching '^/auth/.*' that carry a pre-existing session_id cookie NOT originated from the same source IP within the current window. When the counter exceeds threshold, Envoy returns 429 before proxying to the upstream FastAPI container. Additionally, the Istio PeerAuthentication policy requires mTLS STRICT mode between all mesh services, and the AuthorizationPolicy restricts /auth/login to only accept connections from the ingress gateway VirtualService. The Redis-backed token bucket is keyed on tuple (session_cookie_value, source_ip_hash) ensuring that an attacker attempting to fixate a session from IP-A and have a victim authenticate from IP-B triggers the cross-IP session reuse detection, incrementing the counter for that cookie value. After 3 cross-IP attempts within 60s, all subsequent requests carrying that session cookie are blocked with 429 at the Envoy layer.

config.infrastructure: EKS + Istio service mesh + Envoy sidecar
config.redis_backend: ElastiCache Redis 7.x cluster for token bucket state
config.trigger_condition: session_id cookie used from different source IP than originator
